1. On the CarbonDesk sign-in page, choose Forgot password and enter the account email. The password reset link expires after 30 minutes. [KB-ACCOUNT-001]
2. After five failed login attempts, the account is temporarily locked for 15 minutes. Wait for the lockout to expire before trying again. [KB-ACCOUNT-002]
3. Use an unused recovery code when the MFA device is unavailable. If no recovery code remains, contact human support for identity verification. [KB-ACCOUNT-003]
